source: Part A copied from live socioclimate.io 2026-11-05

live.font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
live.glow-mark: drop-shadow(0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan-glow) 70%, transparent)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 55%, transparent)) drop-shadow(0 0 40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 25%, transparent))

deepWater.hero-light: radial-gradient(60% 55% at 70% 32%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 14%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 4%, transparent) 45%, transparent 72%)
deepWater.caustic: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 60%, transparent), transparent)

luminousArchive.specular: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 18% -10%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 30%, transparent) 0%, transparent 55%)
luminousArchive.glass-liquid: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan-glow) 14%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue-lift) 18%, transparent) 45%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue-deep) 55%, transparent) 100%)
luminousArchive.portal-light: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--paper) 0%, var(--cyan-glow) 18%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 70%, transparent) 55%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 0%, transparent) 100%)
luminousArchive.column-light: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 25%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan-glow) 70%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan) 25%, transparent))
